story.title: Story 4: Chunk Derivation and Compact Recovery

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on SV-04-001 and directly touched surfaces. The missing-member source corruption path now preserves corrupt chunk_member rows, blocks before provider summary calls, has TC-4.8b coverage for both chunk summary types, and passes the configured gates. Prior Story 4 proof for compact no-provider behavior, boundary, warnings/logging, stoppability, and member_projection_not_ready requeue remains intact.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by code and focused probe. readMemberProjections now LEFT JOINs turns and returns sourceCorruptionReason when a chunk member references a missing canonical turn at packages/lhc/src/domains/turns/internal/forms.ts:129-166. chunkSummaryHandler blocks immediately on that reason before provider calls at packages/lhc/src/domains/turns/internal/derive.ts:289-294. TC-4.8b now deletes t1 with foreign_keys disabled and asserts both chunk_summary_detailed and chunk_summary_brief land blocked at packages/lhc/test/chunk-compact-recovery.test.ts:305-324. The prior focused corruption probe now returns blocked with reason source_damaged: canonical record corrupt: chunk c1 member t1 references missing turn.

AC-4.2 / TC-4.2a and AC-4.6 / TC-4.6a: compact no-provider proof remains covered by the full compact path with provider input capture equal to [].
